items.title: Deprecated /api/admin/login endpoint
items.expected_behavior: Retired route must not issue an authenticated session.
items.verified_root_cause: Shared-password admin path had already been retired in favor of directory-backed canonical auth.
items.operational_impact: None after canonical admin login remained functional.
items.security_impact: Positive; obsolete shared-password path is unavailable.
items.final_disposition: Route remains retired and non-operational by design.

items.title: /api/hr/check canonical status
items.expected_behavior: No live runtime consumer and no active route registration.
items.verified_root_cause: Endpoint is no longer registered; canonical HR auth uses current portal routes.
items.final_disposition: No repair required; documented as dead endpoint.

items.title: Field Leadership direct shared-secret login
items.expected_behavior: Only canonical per-user FL auth or Super Admin authority may access FL workflow endpoints; shared secret must not mint a usable session.
items.observed_behavior: Before repair, shared secret MASCIGC minted a token without directory session, portal grant, disabled-user, must-change, or lockout checks. After repair, route returns 410 and legacy header access is denied.
items.verified_root_cause: Legacy shared-secret gate remained linked from the canonical UI and authorized the live FL workflow independently of canonical portal assignment.
items.operational_impact: Legacy entry point could create/submit FL records outside canonical identity controls.
items.final_disposition: Retired the shared-secret login path, removed the UI link, and moved FL workflow auth to canonical per-user validation.

items.title: Dispatch forced-password-change fixture behavior
items.expected_behavior: Fixture may require password change, then portal access must recover and original password must be restorable for Preview reuse.
items.observed_behavior: Flow exercised end-to-end; must-change behavior and restore path worked after password-rotation parity repair.
items.final_disposition: Documented as expected fixture state and verified.

items.title: Admin-only access to /api/incident-cases
items.expected_behavior: Admin-only dual-token users may read incident cases just like safety/pm, without widening auth.
items.observed_behavior: Before repair, admin path produced downstream role='' failures. After repair, admin-only incident reads and review routes pass.
items.verified_root_cause: Shared Safety/Admin/PM read dependency returned a bare boolean for admin instead of an actor object required by downstream role/capability checks.
items.operational_impact: Admin review surfaces failed for authorized operators.
items.security_impact: Medium; denial for intended admin reads, no overexposure.
items.final_disposition: Returned canonical admin actor identity from the shared read gate and reverified admin/safety/pm incident reads.

items.title: PM/Safety review-page failures
items.route_or_endpoint: Incident review pages and /api/incident-cases for PM/Safety
items.expected_behavior: Canonical users must access incident review surfaces with the correct token contract.
items.observed_behavior: Direct and dual-token PM/Safety reads passed; failures reproduced only when X-Directory-Token was omitted.
items.verified_root_cause: Earlier negative result came from incomplete test headers, not the runtime authorization path.
items.final_disposition: Documented dual-token requirement and reverified PM/Safety review access.

items.title: Backup integrity external timeout
items.expected_behavior: Authorized operator starts an integrity check quickly, sees honest running/completed state, no 60s external 502, duplicate launches controlled, result persists across refresh.
items.observed_behavior: Before repair, external edge returned 502 at ~60s while internal execution completed ~72s later. After repair, start returns 202/409 immediately, status/latest persist, legacy GET returns current state, and the latest external run completed PASS in 26.45s with no 502.
items.verified_root_cause: Blocking browser request spent ~68.6s reading recent R2 manifests inline, exceeding the upstream edge timeout. Async job model removed the blocking path and reduced manifest evaluation to the latest applicable artifact.
items.operational_impact: Operators could not complete backup integrity verification through the browser before repair.
items.security_impact: Low direct security impact; high operational visibility impact.
items.final_disposition: Converted the integrity check to an asynchronous persisted job with duplicate-run guard, audit/trust events, and honest operator state.
production_follow_up_required: Actual restore drill remains separate from manifest integrity and was not certified in this sweep.

items.title: Field Leadership record identity attribution under canonical FL auth
items.expected_behavior: Created FL records must retain individual creator identity.
items.observed_behavior: Initial canonical record path stored role but omitted creator identity fields. After follow-up fix, created_by/email and submitted_by fields persist correctly.
items.verified_root_cause: Legacy best-effort record stamping assumed shared-token leadership with no per-user identity.
items.final_disposition: Stamped created_by, updated_by, and submitted_by fields from canonical FL auth context.

items.title: Async integrity job collection caused false missing-from-backup result
items.expected_behavior: Regenerable operator-job collections explicitly excluded from backup doctrine must not force a false FAIL.
items.observed_behavior: Initial async job collection appeared as missing from backup until the runtime exclusion set was applied during integrity evaluation.
items.verified_root_cause: Older backup manifest could not list a collection created by the new async workflow; evaluation needed to union runtime explicit exclusions.
items.operational_impact: Would show a false incomplete result after the repair.
items.final_disposition: Added backup_integrity_jobs to explicit exclusion doctrine and applied runtime exclusions during missing-collection evaluation.
